text: The two types of the route answer, RouteRequest and Approval, have no published element list, so the committee elements the baseline declares are an additive minor version of the element set the sibling baselines of this service start: the escalation flag and the item reference, the limit applied with its level and matrix version, the delegation version, the final call, the coded reason, the elapsed clock and the committee reference. why: TSD S1 T-A.2 names the two types and no field table, the FSD field catalog of A2.9.3.2 is the appraisal catalog, and three slices of the same service must not each invent their own answer.
